paras: DIXCEL 2-Piece Front Rotor Replacement Hardware Kit (Excl. Bobbins) – Honda Civic Type R (FK8 / FL5)

A genuine DIXCEL hardware refresh kit for the 2-piece floating front rotors on the Honda Civic Type R FK8 and FL5. This kit suits both the factory (OEM) 2-piece front rotors and DIXCEL replacement rotor rings. It replaces the bolts, nuts and springs that should be renewed whenever the rotor rings are changed.
